dedupe_keys.name: global gas flaring black carbon emissions 1994 2012

description: The Figshare item Global_FlaringBC provides a global estimate of black carbon emissions from gas flaring for 1994 to 2012. It accompanies a Scientific Data descriptor and has a named child item, Global_FlaringBC. The data item can supply a historical emissions input when a modeller tests oil and gas infrastructure scenarios or atmospheric exposure near flaring regions. It is a reconstructed emissions product, not meter readings at individual flare facilities. Its period ends in 2012, so it cannot represent later changes in gas production without another source. All 1 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I read the article and repository metadata but did not open the data files or test the spatial grid. No directly related catalogue record was found.
